projectDescription: A 2D platformer video game built with Unity 2022, featuring multiple levels, an infinite runner mode, enemy AI, a day/night cycle, checkpoints, collectibles, and a level-select hub — designed as a hobby and learning project.
keyFeatures: Three hand-crafted platform levels plus an endless infinite runner mode
Level-select hub world navigated by the player character
Multiple enemy types: patrol-walking enemies (EnemyMovement), player-tracking AI (EnemyAI), and a jumping bear (BearLs)
Checkpoint system with PlayerPrefs persistence across scene loads
Dynamic day/night color-cycle applied to all background sprites (EventosController)
Procedural map tile generation in infinite mode (MapGenerator)
Cherry (coin) collectibles with random spawning (SpawnerMonedas) and best-score saving
Heart power-ups that restore player health
Pause (P), reset (R), and return-to-menu (M) keyboard shortcuts
TextMesh Pro pixel-font UI overlays for lives, coins, and timer
SunnyLand pixel-art asset pack with animated player states (idle, run, jump, hurt, climb)
publicApiSurface: PlayerLs — main player controller for story levels (velocidad, velocidadCorrer, salto, monedas, vida, time, checkpoint)
PlayerInfinite — player controller for infinite runner mode with best-score saving via PlayerPrefs
PlayerLevels — hub-world player controller that triggers scene loads for each level/mode
EnemyMovement — patrol enemy (speed, distance, direction flip)
EnemyAI — player-tracking enemy (velocidadEnemigo, follows player X axis)
BearLs — jumping patrol bear (salto, speed, distance, intervaloDeSalto)
CameraController — smooth follow camera for both player types
EventosController — background day/night color lerp cycle (tiempoTotal, four Color phases)
MapGenerator — trigger-based infinite map tile spawner (map prefab, espacioMap)
SpawnerMonedas — probabilistic coin spawner on Start
ResetController — pause, reset, and scene-reload logic referencing PlayerLs
MenuController — scene navigation methods: Scena1(), Controles(), Salir(), Menu()
Scenes: Menu, Levels, Controles, Level1, Level2, Level3, Infinite
